## AI-generated Overview (from reference literature)

*This overview was drafted by an AI model from the cited scholarship and catalog data and may contain errors; verify against the sources before relying on it.*

 The largest concentration of shared material is with the commentary, the *Vimānavatthu-aṭṭhakathā* (§4.1–7.4 matching §498–510), as well as its preceding companion text, the *Paṭhamapatibbatāvimānavatthu* (Vv 11, where §1.2–4.1 shares verses with §2.1–5.1) [DharmaNexus]. Extended formulaic passages are also shared with the *Guttilavimānavatthu* (Vv 33), *Dutiyanāvāvimānavatthu* (Vv 7), *Paṭhamanāvāvimānavatthu* (Vv 6), *Dutiyapīṭhavimānavatthu* (Vv 2), and the *Petavatthu-aṭṭhakathā* [DharmaNexus]. In cross-language alignments, DharmaNexus detects low-plausibility automatic matches with the Tibetan *Vinayavibhaṅga* (D0003), though these are machine alignments rather than confirmed historical parallels [DharmaNexus].

*No discussion of this text was found in the reference-literature corpus; the overview relies on catalog and DharmaNexus data.*
